p.quote:
Additionally, both data sharing pressure from journals (𝛽 = .197, 𝑝 > .001) and facilitating conditions
(𝛽 = .094, 𝑝 < .05) positively impacted communication scholars’ intention toward data sharing, a finding
which differs from those reported by Harper and Kim (2018), who found no significant impacts on pressure
from open science journals or the availability of data repositories.
